sources.evidence: Heidelberg Materials' current Sub-Saharan Africa page identifies a grinding plant in Cotonou, Benin as part of its production network; the current Africa-Mediterranean-Western Asia page reports 0.6 million tonnes of cement capacity in Benin for 2025.
Heidelberg Materials' 2025 annual financial statements list Cimbenin SA as a current Group mandate in Benin.

Heidelberg Materials' current Sub-Saharan Africa page identifies a grinding plant in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso; its 2025 regional capacity table reports 1.4 million tonnes of cement capacity in Burkina Faso.

Heidelberg Materials' 2025 annual financial statements list CimBurkina S.A. as a current Group mandate in Burkina Faso; the company's official plant-inauguration release identifies the Ouagadougou cement grinding plant.

CEMENCO's current official site states that Liberia Cement Corporation operates one grinding plant in Monrovia and is a cement supplier in Liberia; Heidelberg Materials' 2025 regional capacity table reports 0.6 million tonnes of cement capacity in Liberia.
Heidelberg Materials' current Sub-Saharan Africa page identifies the Monrovia grinding plant as part of its production network.

name: Austral Cimentos Sofala Dondo cement plant

sources.evidence: Austral Cimentos Sofala's current official site states that Austral Cimentos Sofala S.A. operates a cement factory in Dondo, Sofala Province, Mozambique and produces cement grades 32.5 and 42.5; Heidelberg Materials' 2025 regional capacity table reports 0.4 million tonnes of cement capacity in Mozambique.
Heidelberg Materials' 2025 annual financial statements list Austral Cimentos Sofala SA as a current Group mandate in Mozambique.

Heidelberg Materials' current Togo site identifies Scantogo as a producer and seller of clinker; the current Sub-Saharan Africa page identifies the clinker plant in Tabligbo, Togo. Heidelberg Materials' official plant-inauguration release gives annual capacity of 1.5 million tonnes.
Heidelberg Materials' 2025 annual financial statements list Scantogo Mines SA and Ciments du Togo SA as current Group mandates in Togo.
